judge.price_note: Gemini 4 Argon Standard tier, ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (read 2026-10-21): $2 / $10 per 1M input / output tokens (thinking billed as output) through 2026-11-30, $4 / $20 from 2026-12-01; input charged in full (the implicit-cache discount is ignored: a conservative upper bound)

mapping.prompt: identical: the frozen system text goes in `system_instruction`, the user text in `input`; the prompt fingerprint and every row's prompt_sha256 are the same as for the Anthropic judge
mapping.output cap: max_tokens 8000 -> generation_config.max_output_tokens 8000; for Gemini it is documented as thinking + answer together, as the Anthropic cap was (reasoning counted as output). CANNOT MATCH: tokenizers differ, so 8,000 Gemini tokens is not 8,000 Claude tokens, and at high thinking the model may spend the cap on thinking; such a reply is status "incomplete" and fails exactly like a reply cut at max_tokens (no retry, no choice kept)
mapping.reasoning: Anthropic: the model's default reasoning, no setting. Gemini: generation_config.thinking_level "high" (the highest of low / medium / high; the coordinator's pre-registered choice). CANNOT MATCH: the two are different mechanisms; "high" is the closest to "as much reasoning as the model will do"
mapping.thought text: generation_config.thinking_summaries "none": no thought summary is requested, so none is billed beyond the thinking tokens, and none could enter the stored reply (`raw` is model_output text only)
mapping.temperature: not set for either (the provider default); Gemini 4 Argon documents no temperature setting, so none is sent and --temperature is refused
mapping.other sampling: top_p, top_k, seed, stop sequences: not set
mapping.retries: none: one request per call; a failed request is a failed call (the budget wrapper charges its full worst case and the batch is incomplete)
mapping.streaming: none: one synchronous request; the 65,536 synchronous output limit is above the 8,000 cap
mapping.storage: store false: Google keeps no interaction
mapping.price: USD per 1M tokens, input / output including thinking: 2 / 10 through 2026-11-30, 4 / 20 from 2026-12-01 (Standard tier); the budget reserves every call at 4 / 20; the cached-input discount is ignored
mapping.finish: stop_reason is "end_turn" only for status "completed"; anything else ("incomplete", "failed", "cancelled", ...) is stored as "gemini:<status>" and is never an intact answer

baseline.built_by: rl/ai_judge/build_baseline.sh (git archive HEAD engine, pgd_patch.py, cargo build --release --locked --offline --example pg_pos, 2 jobs)
baseline.printer: Name#<all arguments as compact JSON, keys sorted> for every action without a short name (ChooseRetreatEnergy has none since frozen-4); Energy lists carry the engine order and are sorted when labels are compared; same rule as plans/src/main.rs
baseline.reproduced: a second build from scratch with rl/ai_judge/build_baseline.sh gave the identical sha256

note: Provider change only: the judge is Gemini 4 Argon (gemini-4-argon, thinking level high, 8,000 output tokens including thinking) through the Interactions API, chosen by the coordinator before any build (run 1 on claude-sonnet-5-5 did not pass against km3). The prompt (fingerprint 0cb24215...), judge.FROZEN (the Anthropic freeze's settings, inside the fingerprint), the parser, the invalid-label handling, the no-retry policy, the plan lister and the baseline (engine 70652fff) are exactly the frozen-4 ones. New: providers.py, budget_judge.py (hard spend bound, $15 total), the judge block of this record (provider, settings, prices, mapping and its sources), compare checks each judge row against it. Prices: $2 / $10 per 1M tokens through 2026-11-30, $4 / $20 after; reservations at $4 / $20. The Anthropic freeze (frozen-4) stays valid for its own rows.
